final_message:
Configured DNS on pc1 for the requested hostnames and four mail domains. All 60 PCs and 12 routers now use it for name resolution; their existing addresses, routes, and connections remain unchanged.

The configuration contains 27 address records and four MX records. I checked that each MX target has an address and that all startup scripts pass shell syntax checks. I couldn’t run a live DNS or cross-network test because Kathara and BIND’s validation tools are unavailable in this environment.
